# {{ profile.name }}

> {{ profile.summary | normalize_whitespace }}

{{ profile.name }} is a {{ profile.job_title }}, based in France. This site is his professional portfolio: experience in French digital public services, education in cybersecurity, press coverage, and free security tools for Rails developers. The full text of the site, in Markdown, is in [llms-full.txt]({{ '/llms-full.txt' | absolute_url }}).

- Expertise: {{ profile.knows_about | join: ', ' }}
- Languages: {{ profile.languages | join: ', ' }}
- Contact: {{ site.email }} · [LinkedIn]({{ site.linkedin_url }}) · [GitHub]({{ site.github_url }})

## Main pages

- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): profile, technical expertise and current focus
- [Professional experience]({{ '/experiences/' | absolute_url }}): {{ experiences.size }} positions since {{ first_year }}, mostly for French government digital services
- [Education and training]({{ '/trainings/' | absolute_url }}): {{ trainings.size }} degrees and certifications, including a cybersecurity engineering degree at CNAM, the Le Wagon bootcamp and an ANSSI certification
- [In the media]({{ '/press/' | absolute_url }}): press coverage of his career change from truck driver to web developer
- [Brakeman Report Visualizer]({{ '/brakeman-visualizer/' | absolute_url }}): free, 100% client-side tool to triage Brakeman security reports for Ruby on Rails (compare scans, mark false positives, export config/brakeman.ignore)
- [Contact]({{ '/contact/' | absolute_url }})
